menu_options.detected: Choose an actively allocated Bluetooth device

detected.title: Choose a Bluetooth device
detected.description: The list contains devices that currently own an active Bluetooth connection slot. The source shown after 'via' is informational and is not locked into the configuration.

data_description.address: Choose the device whose connection allocation should be monitored.

manual.title: Enter a Bluetooth address
manual.description: Enter the device address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.

data_description.name: This becomes the Home Assistant device name. The suggested value is editable.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.

abort.already_configured: This Bluetooth address is already monitored.
abort.no_allocated_devices: No actively allocated Bluetooth devices were found. Use manual entry instead.
